patch.value: Approve or amend the noreply identity on the normalize-release-tag-version branch commit

The whole-store privacy gate (npm run privacy) currently exits 1 with two identity:commit findings, both from commit 42297ee on the fix/normalize-release-tag-version branch (also pushed to origin). Its author and committer use the maintainer noreply address with one letter transposed relative to the approved-git-identities entry, so the gate cannot verify it. Discovered while running the privacy check for the public-forms review round; out of scope there. Fix by amending the branch identity to the approved form or approving the address with justification, then re-running the gate.
